text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 12 और 13 पर ‘The Wise Man-II’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 12 aur 13 par ‘The Wise Man-II’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘The Wise Man-II’ on pages 12 and 13 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: What did the thugs ask Bhola?

questionMeaning.hi: ठगों ने भोला से क्या पूछा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Thagon ne Bhola se kya poochha?

options: They asked him to sell his mangoes.
They asked him for his horse.
They asked him the way home.
steps.answer: They asked him to sell his mangoes.
steps.modelAnswer: The thugs asked Bhola, "Will you sell these mangoes, Sir?"

modelMeaning.hi: ठगों ने भोला से पूछा, ‘क्या आप ये आम बेचेंगे?’
modelMeaning.hinglish: Thagon ne Bhola se poochha, ‘Kya aap yeh aam bechenge?’

steps.question: Did Bhola agree to sell the green mangoes?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या भोला हरे आम बेचने को राज़ी हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Bhola hare aam bechne ko raazi hua?

options: No, they were for his wife.
steps.answer: No, they were for his wife.
steps.modelAnswer: No, Bhola did not agree to sell the mangoes because they were for his wife.

modelMeaning.hi: नहीं, भोला आम बेचने को राज़ी नहीं हुआ क्योंकि वे उसकी पत्नी के लिए थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nahi, Bhola aam bechne ko raazi nahi hua kyonki woh uski patni ke liye the.

steps.question: Did Bhola's wife like chutney?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या भोला की पत्नी को चटनी पसंद थी?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Bhola ki patni ko chatni pasand thi?

options: Yes, she liked mango chutney very much.
No, she did not like it.
steps.answer: Yes, she liked mango chutney very much.
steps.modelAnswer: Yes, Bhola's wife liked mango chutney very much.

modelMeaning.hi: हाँ, भोला की पत्नी को आम की चटनी बहुत पसंद थी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Haan, Bhola ki patni ko aam ki chatni bahut pasand thi.

steps.question: What was the bet?
options: Rs 1000 for Bhola if his wife did not get angry; Bhola pays the same if she did.
Bhola would give them his mangoes.
The thugs would buy his hen.
steps.answer: Rs 1000 for Bhola if his wife did not get angry; Bhola pays the same if she did.
steps.modelAnswer: The thugs would give Bhola a thousand rupees if his wife did not get angry. Bhola would pay them the same amount if she went against his decision.

modelMeaning.hi: अगर पत्नी नाराज़ न हो तो ठग भोला को हज़ार रुपये देंगे। अगर वह नाराज़ हो, तो भोला उन्हें उतने ही रुपये देगा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Agar patni naaraaz na ho to thag Bhola ko hazaar rupaye denge. Agar woh naaraaz ho, to Bhola unhe utne hi rupaye dega.

steps.question: How did Bhola plan to spend the money?

questionMeaning.hi: भोला ने पैसे कैसे ख़र्च करने का सोचा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ne paise kaise kharch karne ka socha?

options: He would give it to the Nawab.
steps.modelAnswer: Bhola planned to buy another horse with the money.

modelMeaning.hi: भोला ने उस पैसे से दूसरा घोड़ा ख़रीदने का सोचा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ne us paise se doosra ghoda khareedne ka socha.

text.en: Now the book's ‘tick the correct option’.

steps.question: How much money was offered in the bet?
With whom did Bhola return home?
steps.modelAnswer: Bhola returned home with the two strangers, who were the thugs.

modelMeaning.hi: भोला दो अजनबियों के साथ घर लौटा, जो असल में ठग थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bhola do ajnabiyon ke saath ghar lauta, jo asal mein thag the.

steps.question: Did the thugs succeed in their plan?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या ठग अपनी चाल में कामयाब हुए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya thag apni chaal mein kaamyaab hue?
